sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/111 (ReserveOhio API: search/grid for facilities 452 North and 454 South, search/details for every campsite on 2027-06-15)

values.note: $27 a night for a site without electric; electric $37; full hookups $50. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation; no out-of-state rate. ReserveOhio's prices for June 2027 nights, re-read 2026-10-20.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all 162 Harrison Lake campsites, 2027-06-15 (Rate 27.00 / 37.00 / 50.00, Fee 6.50), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/harrison-lake-state-park-campground ('91 full hook-up sites') + ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '50' on electric and full-hookup sites; Water and Sewer Hookup amenities on the 91 full-hookup sites), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 91 full-hookup, 58 electric and 13 non-electric sites in the North and South campgrounds (ODNR counts 165 including the group camp, a cabin and 2 yurts). Every site with a listed driveway is a back-in; listed maximum camping-unit lengths are mostly 50-53 ft, up to 68.

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/harrison-lake-state-park-campground + ReserveOhio search/details (PullInTypeName, 'Maximum Camping Unit Length'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Off-season (November 1 to April 1) only electric sites 61-83 stay open, with latrines and water; showers and the dump station are closed then.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/harrison-lake-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, & dump station are available'; off-peak 'Latrines and water available'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Off-peak season November 1 to April 1: electric sites 61 through 83 open, with latrines and water but no showers or dump station.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/harrison-lake-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1. Electric sites 61 through 83 are open'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservations up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. ReserveOhio sets a 14-night maximum on each campsite.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/harrison-lake-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/details (MaxStay 14 on every campsite), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed fees ($27 base, +$10 electric, +$23 full hookup, $6.50 reservation fee). Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at the 91 full-hookup sites, 162 back-in sites up to 68 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump/water (latrines in winter), year-round season with a winter loop (sites 61-83, Nov 1-Apr 1), 6-month window and 14-night max. Not stated on the park page: min stay, fcfs (agency rule stands).
